decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - Before the development can be implemented details of parking (including spaces for people with disabilities) shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the spaces shown on the approved drawing shall be available for use before first occupation of any part of the development.

Condition : 3 - The temporary buildings hereby permitted shall be installed for a maximum period of twelve months and the land shall be restored to its former condition within one month of the lapsing of this period.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of 2-storey temporary office accommodation, (Network Recovery Module) office and toilets on existing car park land.
